description:
1. Parse data/raw/orders_export_Q1Q2_2024.csv, handling messy headers (mixed case, whitespace), blank rows, and missing qty values (treat as 1). Group line items by Order_ID to build market baskets.
2. Compute association metrics (support, confidence, lift) across item pairs/triples to identify the strongest co-purchase patterns: TENT-2P-GRN+SLEEP-BAG-20F+PAD-FOAM-RL, BOOT-HK42+SOCK-WL01+POLE-ALU-PR, STOVE-CMP+FUEL-CANN, PACK-45L-BK+HEADLAMP-CR+FILTER-H2O.
3. Write a methodology note explaining order-ID grouping, any time window, minimum thresholds, and which metrics are reported.
4. Produce at least TWO bundle recommendation cards in the EXACT 5-line labeled format: [Hero SKU] — / [Accessory A] — / [Accessory B] — / [Bundle discount price] — / [One-click checkout hook] —
5. Include a supplementary Markdown table with exactly 5 columns: 'If customer buys (A) | Recommend (B) | Association metric (value) | PDP / FBT placement | Discount / hook summary' with at least 4 data rows.
6. End with a 'Logic chain' subsection using arrow (→) or numbered priority rules testable in a cart engine.
7. Save everything to bundle_recommendations.md.
